title: 摸乳巷-遊憩景點-彰化旅遊資訊網
description:
Mōrǔ Xiàng (Breast-Touching Lane)

Nestled in Lukang, Changhua County, this historic alley measures under 70 centimeters at its narrowest point, forcing passersby to brush shoulders as they traverse the red-brick corridor. A faded red doorframe at the entrance displays vertical couplets reading “摸乳巷裡無乳摸,” hinting at the alley’s cheeky moniker. Overhead, verdant foliage softens the brick walls, while a lone visitor stands at the far end, illustrating the alley’s intimate scale.

Originally designed as a firebreak between long row houses and to shield interiors from strong sea winds, the passage earned various names—“Chest-Guarding Lane” and “Gentlemen’s Lane”—before the blunt “Breast-Touching Lane” became most renowned. A folk tale suggests the name also echoes “Dream Lane,” reflecting ancient hopes for childbirth, which over time merged phonetically into the current title.

supplementary.description:
Lukang Old Street Alley

A quiet, narrow alley in Lukang Old Street showcases red-brick facades and a row of parked scooters along a tiled pathway. Overhead electrical wires crisscross above, while a small wooden lantern affixed to the wall evokes the district’s historic charm. Potted greenery and glimpses of traditional doorways further enrich the scene.

This setting is part of a guided tour in Changhua County that highlights the preservation of century-old buildings, local crafts, and cultural heritage. Visitors explore sites like Tianhou Temple, half-wells, and restored residences, learning how sustainable practices and adaptive reuse keep Lukang’s stories alive.
